title: The Health Connect page says only workouts logged in MettleUp are sent, but imported workouts are sent too
what: Under Send past workouts the app says only workouts logged in MettleUp are sent. But workouts brought in from a Hevy or Strong file are sent to Health Connect by themselves right after the import, whenever sending is on. And when the phone cannot tell when MettleUp first ran, every workout on the phone is sent, old ones included, with no such line. The data only goes to Health Connect on the member's own phone, so nothing reaches another company, but the line tells the member something that is not true.
expected: The words under Send past workouts match what is really sent: they also name imported workouts, or imported workouts follow the same rule.
who: members who send workouts to Health Connect and import a Hevy or Strong file
how_often: every import while Health Connect sending is on
fix_line: Change the line to say imported workouts are sent too, or hold imported workouts back the same way.

title: Weigh-ins from Health Connect would reach the gym and an AI if two switched-off features came back
what: Weigh-ins read from Health Connect go into the same body-weight log as typed ones, with no lasting mark of where they came from. Two features that are switched off today read the newest body weight from that log: the old gym sync puts it in a summary the gym's dashboard shows in its member list, and the AI coach gets it in its day snapshot. The privacy notice promises Health Connect data never goes to the gym or to any AI, and the gym table in the notice does not list body weight at all. Nothing is sent today because both switches are off.
expected: Before either feature is turned on again, weigh-ins that came from Health Connect are left out of what goes to the gym and to the AI, or the notice and Health Connect's rules allow it.
who: members who let MettleUp read weight from Health Connect
how_often: only if gym sync or the AI coach is switched back on
fix_line: Keep a mark on weigh-ins from Health Connect and leave them out of anything sent to the gym or an AI; add a test that blocks it.
